title: Wire SeatState.Bot roster occupancy for bot-filled seats + HumanIdle scenario (TASK-038 AC5 completion)
description: Filed from the TASK-038 review (rev-t038 FULL, MEDIUM M1 + LOW L1). TASK-038 delivered the bot system and proved the AC5 LIVENESS property (a Novato IBotPolicy supplies continuous input driving a real mechanic through a full SessionStateMachine session that reaches GameOver without stalling any phase). BUT the integration test does NOT assign SeatState.Bot — the roster keeps the filled seat Empty, so the bot's input for it is largely inert; what is actually proven is 'bot input doesn't regress FSM liveness', which makes 'fills a seat' functionally thin. Also only the 'Empty' half of AC5's 'Empty/Idle' is exercised; the 'Idle' (HumanIdle) half has no dedicated scenario. SessionStateMachine.CompleteJoin assigns only Human/Empty off real Join claims; wiring an unclaimed seat to SeatState.Bot is explicit future work the FSM's own class doc defers past TASK-038. WORK: (1) Wire SeatState.Bot roster occupancy so an unclaimed/idle seat is actually OCCUPIED by a Novato bot (roster state = Bot + a published avatar), so the bot genuinely fills the seat rather than feeding inert input to an Empty slot, driving it through a full session that reaches GameOver with no stall. (2) Add a HumanIdle seat-fill scenario (a claimed-then-idle seat handed to a bot) covering the 'Idle' half of AC5. (3) Confirm SeatState.Bot occupancy interoperates with the TASK-056 dead-seat tracker (which currently watches only claimed Human seats) without regression. (4) Fold in rev-t038 LOW-1: EsquivaBotPolicy.cs:30's doc claims the extended diagnosis is 'still present verbatim on Barcade.SlowTests.Oracles.EsquivaEscapeBot', but that file was DELETED in b7282cc — correct the stale present-tense cross-ref (content already summarized on EsquivaBotPolicy's own doc, nothing lost). Read the SessionStateMachine roster/SeatState code + TASK-038's Core/Runtime/Bots/ module. Core/session logic is fast-testable.
acceptance_criteria: An unclaimed (Empty) seat is occupied by a Novato bot with SeatState.Bot roster state and a published avatar, and the bot genuinely drives that seat (not inert input to an Empty slot) through a full session that reaches GameOver without stalling any phase
A HumanIdle seat-fill scenario (a claimed-then-idle seat handed to a bot) is covered by an integration test — the 'Idle' half of AC5
SeatState.Bot occupancy interoperates with the TASK-056 dead-seat tracker without regression (the tracker's claimed-Human assumption is reconciled)
rev-t038 LOW-1 doc fix applied: EsquivaBotPolicy.cs:30's stale present-tense cross-ref to the deleted EsquivaEscapeBot is corrected. Tests-first where engine-free; fast suite green, no regression
